messages:
Maya (docs): Drafted release notes + changelog for the docs site. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/621. Need quick eyes on: accuracy of feature bullets, known-issue wording, and SDK snippet parity across Node/Python.

Ravi: Skimmed. Two quick items: 1) 'Optimize' bullet should mention batching is beta; 2) the Node streaming example is missing in the examples folder.

Sofia: Found a stale link in the embeddings deprecation note that points to /v1/embeds/stream — needs to be updated to the unified embeddings path and include a migration tip. Also one redirect for /docs/sdk/node/examples is 301ing to a preview host.

Maya (docs): Thanks. Action items: @Ravi add Node snippet + patch examples; @Sofia open redirect PR and update embed path; I'll rephrase bullets to be metric-backed and less marketing-y.

Ravi: Added Node snippet commit -> https://git.internal/redwood/docs/commit/ff11ee. Snippet (short): ```js
const st = await client.responses.stream({model:'rw-infer-1', input:'hi'});
for await (const c of st) process.stdout.write(c.text)
```

Sofia: Redirect PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/623. Updated embedding path in the release notes in a small patch, tagging Maya.

deploy-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/changes/621 (expires in 72h).

Maya (docs): Great progress. If we merge these by EOD I can schedule the deploy tomorrow morning. If not, we'll hide the Optimize beta mention until follow-up. :thumbsup:
